senses.gloss:
रौप्य रौप्य, अस्, &c. (fr. रूप्य), made of
silver, silver; like silver, silvery; (आ), f., N. of a
place; (अम्), n. silver.
—रौप्य-मय, अस्, ई, अम्,
consisting of silver, made of silver, silver.
—रौप्य-
माषक, अस्, m. a Māṣaka weight of silver.
रौप्यायणि, इस्, m. a patronymic from Rūpya.
